title: Family-Friendly 2‑BR 30A Vacation Home with Beach Access
meta_description: Stay at Coastal Charm, a 2-BR, 2-bath 30A Seagrove vacation home with a bonus bunk area, private pool, and beach access. Accommodates 9 guests.
description_expanded: Looking for a family-friendly 30A getaway with a private pool and easy beach access?Coastal Charm is a spacious 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom retreat with a bonus bunk area, comfortably accommodating up to 9 guests. Located in a quiet Seagrove neighborhood, this home offers the comfort of a cottage-style retreat with the convenience of being just a short walk from the beautiful emerald waters and sugar-white sands of the Gulf. The fully fenced yard, heated and chilled pool, and relaxed coastal atmosphere make it the perfect spot for families or groups looking to enjoy all the best that 30A has to offer.Start your mornings on the front deck, sipping coffee while surrounded by the peaceful, tree-lined neighborhood. Inside, large windows bring in an abundance of natural light, creating a bright and welcoming atmosphere throughout the home. The living room features a queen-sized sleeper sofa and flat-screen TV, providing a cozy space for movie nights after a day at the beach or by the pool. The fully equipped kitchen is ready for you to prepare home-cooked meals, with a coffee maker, toaster, microwave, and full-sized appliances. The adjacent dining area offers seating for four, with an additional breakfast bar for casual dining or a quick snack. A washer and dryer are available for your convenience during longer stays.Sleeping Arrangements:Master Bedroom: King bed, TV, bookshelf, ensuite bathroom with walk-in showerGuest Bedroom: Queen bed, TV, access to shared bathroom with tub/shower comboBonus Bunk Area: Triple-level bunk bed (Twin over Twin over Twin)*Sofa in the living area pulls out to a queen-sized bed.Step outside to the private backyard, a perfect spot for cookouts, casual gatherings, or small celebrations. The BBQ grill and picnic table make outdoor dining easy, and the outdoor shower is ideal for rinsing off after a fun day at the beach. The private pool provides a refreshing way to cool off (heating available for a fee). As the evening cools, gather around the fire pit for some marshmallows and shared stories. Four bikes are also available, allowing you to explore the neighborhood, visit nearby Seaside or WaterColor, or enjoy the local bike trails.Coastal Charm is ideally located close to some of the best dining, shopping, and entertainment on 30A. You’ll be just a short drive or bike ride away from popular spots like Greenway Station, Café 30A, Seagrove Market, Surfing Deer, The Perfect Pig, and Old Florida Fish House, each offering a unique taste of local cuisine. Seaside and WaterColor are also nearby, both offering distinctive shops, galleries, and a wide variety of dining options, from casual cafes to more upscale eateries. Whether you're in the mood for fresh seafood, gourmet coffee, or a vibrant beachside atmosphere, you’ll find it all within easy reach. Plus, with nearby beaches and trails, there are plenty of opportunities for outdoor activities, including biking, hiking, and water sports.Your stay at Coastal Charm comes with Xplorie’s best activities! Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!Additional Information:* Sorry, no pets are allowed.* Snowbird Friendly!* Parking for 4 cars.A Benchmark initial starter kit of amenities are provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
